site.title: ShiggyBot
site.description: A Discord bot built with C# 13 and .NET 10.

hero.headline: ShiggyBot
hero.subheadline: A modular Discord bot built with C# 13 and .NET 10 using Discord.Net

overview.title: What is ShiggyBot?
overview.body: A self-hosted Discord bot you configure, deploy, and extend. It connects to Discord via a bot token, loads modular commands, and initializes optional runtime features — autorole, presence updates, code previews, and more — at startup.

architecture.title: Architecture at a Glance
architecture.subtitle: Modular, decoupled, and extensible by design.

principles.title: Modular
principles.description: Commands and features are plug-ins discovered at startup, making the bot easy to extend without touching core code.

principles.title: Decoupled
principles.description: The core runtime has minimal knowledge of specific commands, keeping the system maintainable as it grows.

principles.title: Configurable
principles.description: Settings drive behavior through config files and environment variables — no hardcoded values.

principles.title: Observable
principles.description: Optional webhook logging for production monitoring, with per-event filtering and error reporting.

components.name: Program.cs
components.description: Entry point — loads config, registers services, starts the bot

components.name: DiscordClientService
components.description: Central orchestrator — client lifecycle, event wiring, connection management

components.name: CommandHandler
components.description: Discovers and dispatches commands implementing ICommand

components.name: Features
components.description: Runtime capabilities — Autorole, Presence, CodePreview, and more

components.name: DatabaseService
components.description: SQLite persistence layer — bans, command state, guild settings

components.name: WebhookLogger
components.description: Optional webhook-based log sink for real-time monitoring

features.title: Features
features.subtitle: Everything you need to manage and engage your community.

items.title: Moderation
items.description: Timed bans, kick, timeout, purge, nuke, role management, and per-guild command gating.

items.title: Code Previews
items.description: Automatic inline previews of code from GitHub, GitLab, and other forges.

items.title: Plugin Search
items.description: Remote plugin index with Levenshtein search and one-click ephemeral install.

items.title: Fun Commands
items.description: Image compositing with ImageSharp, Google search links, and more.

items.title: Autorole
items.description: Automatic role assignment on member join. Configurable per guild.

items.title: GitHub Stats
items.description: Rotating presence with repo stats, commit/PR/star monitoring.

techStack.title: Tech Stack
techStack.subtitle: Built with modern tooling from the ground up.

commands.title: Commands
commands.subtitle: All commands are prefixed with {prefix}. Arguments in brackets are optional, angle brackets are required.

commands.name: help
commands.description: Shows the help menu. Uses an interactive select menu (V2) or falls back to embed-based help (V1).

commands.name: note <key>
commands.description: Shows one of 8 hard-coded notes about ShiggyCord. Supports reply-to.

commands.name: ban
commands.description: Bans a user, optionally timed (7d, 30m, etc.). Purges 7 days of messages. Supports reply-to shortcut. Persists to database.

commands.name: kick
commands.description: Kicks a user from the server. Supports reply-to shortcut.

commands.name: timeout
commands.description: Times out a user. Supports reply-to shortcut.

commands.name: purge
commands.description: Bulk-deletes messages (1–100). Subject to Discord's 14-day message deletion limit.

commands.name: nuke
commands.description: Clones the current channel and deletes the original. Admin only.

commands.name: addrole
commands.description: Adds a role to a user. Supports reply-to shortcut.

commands.name: removerole
commands.description: Removes a role from a user. Supports reply-to shortcut.

commands.name: disable
commands.description: Disables a command per-guild. Requires ManageGuild permission. Persists to database.

commands.name: enable
commands.description: Re-enables a disabled command per-guild. Requires ManageGuild permission.

commands.name: plugin
commands.description: Searches a remote plugin index (60 min cache) using Levenshtein distance. Shows an ephemeral install button.

commands.name: google
commands.description: Generates a Google search link. Aliases: g, search.

commands.name: mpreg
commands.description: Composites the user's avatar using ImageSharp. Results cached in memory (100 items) and on disk.

commands.name: setwelcome
commands.description: Sets the autorole for new members. Use disable, none, or off to disable.

commands.name: v1
commands.description: Owner-only command for testing V1 components.

commands.name: v2
commands.description: Owner-only command for testing V2 components. Pass raw to see the JSON payload.

cta.title: Ready to get started?
cta.description:
Clone the repo, configure your token, and run.
Zero external dependencies beyond Discord and SQLite.
